procedures.title: Installation Procedure
preconditions: Suitable mounting location identified on boat
steps: Select mounting location considering compact dimensions
Ensure proper clearance for air outlet
Mount unit securely considering low weight factor
Connect to power supply
Adjust 135° adjustable air outlet as needed
procedures.expected_outcome: Unit securely mounted with proper airflow
models: New Generation Inverter BLDC Self-Contained Unit

procedures.title: ECO Mode Operation
steps: Activate ECO mode
Monitor power consumption stays within 150-200W range
Verify silent operation
Check temperature stability
procedures.expected_outcome: Unit operating efficiently in ECO mode with stable temperature
models: New Generation Inverter BLDC Self-Contained Unit

procedures.title: UV/C LED Air Sterilizer Installation
steps: Access sterilizer mounting location
Install UV/C LED kit according to provided instructions
Verify proper connection to main unit
procedures.expected_outcome: Air sterilizer properly installed and functioning
models: New Generation Inverter BLDC Self-Contained Unit

procedures.title: Wi-Fi Module Setup
steps: Install Wi-Fi module
Connect to power
Configure module through control app
Test remote operation functionality
procedures.expected_outcome: Wi-Fi control operational through app
models: New Generation Inverter BLDC Self-Contained Unit

procedures.title: BLDC Inverter Startup Procedure
steps: System starts at low frequency (20 Hz)
Gradually accelerates to maximum frequency (100 Hz)
Adjusts speed based on temperature requirements
Reduces speed as room temperature approaches setpoint
procedures.expected_outcome: Efficient cooling/heating with minimal power consumption

procedures.title: ECO Function Operation
steps: Select minimum fan speed setting
System will operate at reduced power consumption mode
procedures.expected_outcome: Reduced power consumption while maintaining cooling

procedures.title: Electric Box Installation
steps: Determine if electric box needs to be detached
If needed, detach electric box from main unit
Install stainless steel fixing brackets (if using wall mounting option)
Mount electric box in desired location
Ensure proper connections are maintained
procedures.expected_outcome: Properly mounted and connected electric box

procedures.title: Optional Accessories Installation
steps: Install air exit adapters if needed (square to round or round to oval)
Mount stainless steel fixing brackets if wall mounting electric box
Install WI-FI module if required
Install Air UVA/C sterilizer kit if required
procedures.expected_outcome: Successfully installed optional accessories

procedures.title: Unit Installation Clearance Requirements
steps: Ensure minimum clearance of 40mm (1.57in) on left side
Ensure minimum clearance of 40mm (1.57in) on right side
Allow 235.5mm (9.27in) clearance for depth
Verify 11.2mm (0.44in) mounting holes are accessible
procedures.expected_outcome: Proper clearance for unit installation and operation

procedures.title: Seawater Flow Setup
steps: For SCU07VFD models: Set minimum flow rate to 0.8 m3/h
For SCU07VFD models: Verify pressure drop is 1.8m H2O
For SCU07VFD models: Set maximum flow rate to 1.0 m3/h
For SCU07VFD models: Verify pressure drop is 2.8m H2O
Ensure water connections match 16Ø (0.62in) specifications
procedures.expected_outcome: Proper seawater flow established for operation

procedures.title: Air Duct Installation
steps: Verify duct opening diameter of 120mm (5in)
Install air exit duct according to specifications
Ensure proper sealing around duct connections
procedures.expected_outcome: Air duct properly installed and sealed

procedures.title: ECO Mode Configuration
steps: Set fan speed to minimum
Verify cooling capacity at 3,000 BTU/h
Confirm input power consumption at 150W
procedures.expected_outcome: Unit operating in energy-efficient ECO mode

procedures.title: Remote Electric Box Installation
steps: Verify mounting space of 232 x 277 x 76 mm
Mount electrical box using appropriate fasteners
Connect electrical connections according to voltage specifications
Verify proper grounding
procedures.expected_outcome: Remote electric box properly installed and connected

procedures.title: Unit Installation Dimensional Requirements
preconditions: Unit must be installed in a ventilated space
steps: Ensure minimum width clearance of 500mm (19.7in)
Ensure minimum height clearance of 336mm (13.2in) including electrical box
Ensure minimum depth clearance of 290mm (11.4in)
Account for unit weight of 27kg (59.5lb) when mounting
procedures.expected_outcome: Unit properly positioned with adequate clearance for operation

procedures.title: Seawater Flow Setup - SCU12VFD Models
steps: Ensure minimum seawater flow of 1.2 m3/h (5.3 gpm)
Maintain maximum seawater flow at 1.3 m3/h (5.7 gpm)
Verify pressure drop does not exceed 4.2m H2O (13.8 feet H2O)
procedures.expected_outcome: Proper seawater flow established for optimal operation

procedures.title: Seawater Flow Setup - SCU16VFD Models
steps: Ensure minimum seawater flow of 1.3 m3/h (5.7 gpm)
Maintain maximum seawater flow at 1.4 m3/h (6.2 gpm)
Verify pressure drop does not exceed 4.9m H2O (16.1 feet H2O)
procedures.expected_outcome: Proper seawater flow established for optimal operation
